sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT KEP_SEQ, BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND BUYER = 'KRLOTTG004' ORDER BY KEP_SEQ ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100

SELECT KEP_SEQ AS IF_SEQ, STATUS, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME, CASE WHEN BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE 'NO_CODE%' THEN ' ' ELSE BUYER_ITEM_NO END BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SUBSTR(SPECIFICATION, 1, 30) AS SPECIFICATION, ITEM_GROUP, UNIT_MEASURE, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, CATEGORY_PATH, ITEM_TYPE, PLANT, ' ' AS KEY_1, ' ' AS KEY_2, ' ' AS KEY_3, ' ' AS KEY_4, ' ' AS KEY_5, ' ' AS KEY_6, ' ' AS KEY_7, ' ' AS KEY_8, ' ' AS KEY_9, ' ' AS KEY_10 FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE KEP_SEQ = #KEP_SEQ# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = CASE WHEN MAIN_FLAG = 'N' AND #IF_FLAG# = 'T' THEN 'Y' ELSE #IF_FLAG# END , IF_MSG = 'Item Master : ' || #IF_MSG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE KEP_SEQ = #KEP_SEQ#
